about.title: About
about.lead: From publisher to leading builds and renewals.
intro: A frontend developer with 9 years and 40+ web projects for enterprise and public-sector clients, including Korean Air, Samsung Display, SK hynix, LG, GS E&C, Hyundai Marine, Hanwha, and Daewoong Pharmaceutical.

I started as a publisher and grew into frontend development; today I lead a dev team owning builds and renewals. Depending on what a project needs, I can step into either the publishing or the development side.
I led the full migration of legacy PHP · jQuery services to Next.js / TypeScript — from information architecture through to cutover.
My work has centered on projects with explicit requirements — accessibility (WA), SEO, multilingual, kiosks — and agency work has made me comfortable ramping into unfamiliar domains on short cycles.
education: B.S. Computer Engineering, Academic Credit Bank System (transfer) · Feb 2025
training: React.js (TypeScript · Router · Redux) · Korea Software Inc. · 2020
